mechanism: Bumetanide causes electrolyte depletion (hypokalemia, hypomagnesemia) which may increase QT prolongation risk with rilpivirine, a non-nucleoside reverse transcriptase inhibitor with known QT-prolonging potential.
action: Monitor electrolytes regularly, maintain adequate potassium and magnesium levels, perform baseline and periodic ECG monitoring, and consider alternative diuretics if QT prolongation develops.
